title: decade becomes a workspace member beside decade-channel
body:
The root `Cargo.toml` is both the workspace and the `decade` package. `src/` sits at the root, and `decade-channel/` is the only workspace member.

## Proposal

The root `Cargo.toml` becomes a virtual manifest that lists `decade` and `decade-channel` as members. `[workspace.package]` holds edition, rust-version, license, authors and repository, and each crate inherits them. `decade/` holds the package's `Cargo.toml`, `src/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` and license files. The root keeps a short workspace README, `docs/`, `scripts/`, `Cargo.lock` and `target/`.

Release tags become `<crate>-v<version>` for both crates. The tag `v0.1.0` stays as it is.
